name: another-law
title: Judging a report under another law
idea: A report chosen under one posterior and judged under another can have a different risk; within the same family its regret is at most twice the largest weighted gap between the two laws' pair error probabilities, plus the optimizer's gap.
from: new concept · v1 storyboard P-11; theory book ch. 16 and 18 (regret under a different law); picture: two posteriors for the same units, a report chosen under one and judged under both, its regret and the bound 2d + η
credit: After the postrank theory book, ch. 16 and 18.
caption: Six fictional sites, reading score only: two independent normal laws set by hand for teaching. A law is declared for selection and another for evaluation; this comparison does not establish empirical calibration.
